neet_phy_u07_t09_4.working: A: h ∝ 1/r, so the rise doubles (I). B: effective g = 0, so liquid rises to the full tube length (II). C: mercury in glass has an obtuse contact angle, so it is depressed with a convex meniscus (III). D: in a short tube hR stays constant, so the meniscus radius grows and there is no overflow (IV).

neet_phy_u07_t09_5.working: A is true: S is larger at lower temperature, so the rise is greater. B is false: only half the work, πrSh, is stored as potential energy; the rest is lost as heat. C is true: merging reduces surface area, releasing energy. D is true: an acute contact angle gives a concave meniscus. E is false: each droplet has radius R/27^(1/3) = R/3. Correct set is A, C, D.
